prompt:
You write realistic phone-call wording for a clinic scheduling test set.
For each scenario below, write what the caller would actually say for each listed field, the way a
note-taking assistant would record the caller's own words for that field (a short phrase, not a full
sentence). Vary the style across scenarios: casual, terse, older caller, non-native speaker, rambling.
Use only the facts in the scenario; do not add any other doctor, clinic or service. When the scenario
says the caller does not know the medical name, describe the need the way a layperson would, without
naming a medical specialty or a type of appointment. Do not use tools or open files; answer directly.

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per scenario: {"id": ..., "<field>": "...", ...} with exactly the
fields listed for that scenario.

Scenarios:
- id h3-25: Existing patient whose doctor ordered a CBC blood test; they say 'CBC'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-26: An older existing patient whose doctor ordered pictures of their lungs; they call it 'chest films'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-27: Existing patient whose doctor ordered the big magnet scan of their knee; they call it 'the magnet scan' and never say MRI. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-28: Existing patient whose doctor ordered a sonogram of their thyroid; they say 'sonogram'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-29: Existing patient who wants her yearly checkup with the gynecologist; she calls it her 'yearly with the gyno'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-30: Existing patient whose doctor ordered an MRI. They do not say which body part. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-31: Existing patient whose stomach doctor said they need a scope, but they do not remember whether it goes down the throat or in from below. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-32: Existing patient who wants their yearly all-over skin check to look for signs of skin cancer. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-33: Existing dental patient who is due for their regular six-month checkup at the dentist. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-34: Existing patient who just had shoulder surgery and needs to start PT; they say 'PT'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-35: Existing patient who keeps getting up at night to pee; their doctor told them to get their prostate looked at by a specialist. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-x01: A brand-new patient who has never been seen here wants a cortisone shot in their knee; an outside doctor referred them. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
